title: ‘The Mandalorian and Grogu’ Review: This Supersized Episode Is ‘Star Wars’ at Its Most Generic
summary: Inessential and inoffensive, frequently adorable and fun for the whole family, Jon Favreau’s film feels like three good-enough TV episodes smushed together.

title: ‘Her Private Hell’ Review: More Like Our Public Anguish, Nicolas Winding Refn’s Ghastly Thriller Despises Its Audience
summary: Cannes: Starring Sophie Thatcher and Charles Melton delivering lines at .25x speed, this neon-drowned endurance test is one of the most miserable theatrical viewing experiences in years.

title: ‘Ben’Imana’ Review: Survivors of the Rwandan Genocide Consider the Meaning of Justice in Marie-Clémentine Dusabejambo’s Remarkable Debut
summary: Cannes: The first Rwandan feature ever to play at the festival is a deeply moving drama about genocide survivors reckoning with what they can bear to forgive — in public and private.

title: Miles Teller Opens Up About ‘Paper Tiger,’ Adam Driver, and Losing His Home Before Filming James Gray’s Movie
summary: In James Gray's Cannes hit about two brothers falling out with the Russian mafia, Teller plays against type as a sensitive family man opposite Adam Driver and Scarlett Johansson.

title: Cannes 2026 Movies Sold So Far: Netflix Buys Critics Week Animated Feature ‘In Waves’
summary: The film directed by Phuong Mai Nguyen features the voice talent of Will Sharpe and Stephanie Hsu.

title: ‘Strawberries’ Review: The Indignities Faced by Migrant Workers Unfold Through the Eyes of a Brilliant Young Actress
summary: Director Laila Marrakchi pulls from real stories of Moroccan immigrants to construct a damning indictment of a labor system that leaves them voiceless.

title: At the Cannes Film Festival, We Saw the Center of Gravity Shifting
summary: As Hollywood retrenches, Cannes and Cannes Lions increasingly reflect the same industry-wide question: where audiences, capital, and cultural influence are moving next.

title: ‘All the Lovers in the Night’ Review: Sensitive and Restrained Kawakami Adaptation Shimmers Upon Inspection
summary: Cannes: Nothing but life happens in Yukiko Sode’s elusive adaptation of Mieko Kawakami’s bestseller.

title: At The American Pavilion, Cannes Publicists Got Candid About What Actually Does (and Doesn’t) Sell a Movie
summary: At IndieWire's "What No One Tells You: The Secrets of PR Pros," some of the industry's best publicists explained how the game has changed.

title: It Wasn’t Just YouTubers Who Fixated on ‘Obsession’ This Weekend
summary: Curry Barker's debut horror film made $17.2 million in its opening weekend with an A- CinemaScore, a rare feat for a genre film.

title: ‘Full Phil’ Review: Quentin Dupieux’s Unfulfilling Father-Daughter Two Hander
summary: Cannes: Kristen Stewart and Woody Harrelson swim in circles, in a mildly surreal comedy-drama that works better on paper.

title: Who Will Win the Cannes Film Festival Palme d’Or?
summary: Cannes: We rank the contenders out of the 2026 edition so far, with "Paper Tiger," "All of a Sudden," "Fatherland," and even the sci-fi monster movie "Hope" on the up.
